title: Woman Refuses To Leave Hotel After Getting Overly Drunk
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 1st, 2023. Officers were called to a hotel regarding a highly intoxicated woman, who was refusing to leave. When officers arrived she was very uncooperative and refused to comply to officers commands.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
